items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: the best recorded example I can think was made by Bix from Monday on in Mississippi Mud with Whiteman.

ctx.x: Now, you wouldn't say that the riff was a characteristic of Chicago. It isn't quite that, is it?

No, but particular riffs were where they were very... Well, one example, for example... I mean, one example is that type of phrase that I was just humming. Freeman did it. Still does it. McPartland played it many, many times. And on one occasion, the best recorded example I can think was made by Bix from Monday on in Mississippi Mud with Whiteman.
